blocks.text: AI saves you a lot of time with writing: you give the essence, it gives you well-written text. You always read it and you send it.

items: Say who you're writing to and your relationship (boss, neighbour, company).
Say what you want to achieve (apology, complaint, thanks, request).
Give the key facts (dates, numbers, names).
Ask for a tone: polite, short, firm.

blocks.text: Write a short, polite email to my internet provider. My internet hasn't worked since Monday and I've already called twice. I'm asking them to send a technician this week and to reduce my bill.
You don't have to start from zero. Paste your text and ask: "Fix the mistakes", "Cut it in half", "Make it sound more professional".
AI can tidy up your CV and write a cover letter tailored to a job ad. Give it your real experience and the text of the ad.
Here is my experience: [your experience]. Here is the job ad: [ad text]. Write a 150-word cover letter that highlights what the ad asks for. Don't invent experience I don't have.
Never let the AI invent degrees or experience. Everything in your CV must be true – employers check.
Claude is especially good at writing and polishing text – ask it for 2–3 versions so you can pick one.
In ChatGPT you can ask for 2–3 versions of a text at once and choose the best one.
If you use Gmail, Gemini can also help you write emails directly inside Google apps (depending on your plan).
